summary: Healthy overall. The write services are clean, chassis-backed, and well-tested. Hot-spots: offering-service carries the saga-orchestration complexity and has the highest cyclomatic density; frontend has thin unit coverage and lives by e2e. Shared-chassis is reused everywhere, so regressions propagate — invest in its contract tests.

fragileAreas: circuit breaker state transitions under concurrent failure bursts
env-var newline escaping in public key distribution
outbox listener startup race on cold boot with empty queue
cached_characteristics divergence during long partition windows
locked_by_saga_id cleanup on process crash — no watchdog
saga compensation ordering assumes external workers run in a specific order
out-of-order event arrival under heavy replay
ES index template drift vs. Motor doc shape
saga polling has no max-duration cutoff
auth-context localStorage access is client-only, but some hooks run during SSR warmup
public key rotation requires full service restart — no hot-reload path
